analyst_observations: The skill achieves 100% pass rate vs 33% baseline — a dramatic improvement in structured output quality.

Baseline passes only 'content quality' assertions (audience-fit, balanced-tone) but fails all 'process' assertions (multi-draft, review-gate, fact-check, headline-options). This is expected — without the skill, Claude produces a single good article but has no multi-agent pipeline.

Cost: ~1.84x more tokens and ~6x more time. This is the price of running a 7-phase pipeline with parallel subagents. For professional content production where quality matters, this tradeoff is worthwhile.
The char-count assertion for Eval 2 baseline failed (5000 vs 2000 target) — suggesting the skill's structured outline phase helps with length discipline.

Non-discriminating assertions: audience-fit and balanced-tone pass in both configurations, suggesting Claude's baseline writing quality is already good for tone/audience targeting. The skill's value-add is in process structure, not raw writing quality.
